releaseNotes:
• Fixed Library store persistence: liked songs, saved albums, followed artists, and playlists reliably stored with metadata
• In-playlist YouTube Music online song search: search millions of songs and instantly add/remove them with pill buttons and spring haptics
• Enforced pure audio songs-only filter for playlist additions
• Library 'Songs' tab now aggregates all liked and playlist songs dynamically
• Real-time Room Together collaborative listening with democratic fair queue and sub-millisecond clock sync
• Pure InnerTube decentralized 160 kbps Opus streaming on-device
• Anti-clipping ReplayGain limiter with hyperbolic tangent ceiling
